## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与改后表现

Explain the concrete trigger, visible change and linked issue (`Fixes #...` when appropriate).

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and tested the changed success/failure behavior.
- [ ] JVM tests and lint pass; any device tests I did not run are listed below.
- [ ] UI/lifecycle changes include device evidence (API/ABI, steps and outcome).
- [ ] No credentials, private files, signing keys or unrelated generated output are included.
- [ ] Dependency/binary updates include upstream version, licenses, provenance and compatibility notes.

Commands, test results, screenshots and untested limits:

## Compatibility and maintenance / 兼容与维护

Describe effects on existing projects, settings, plugin formats, file data and rollback when applicable.
Do not change minSdk/targetSdk, Git credential behavior or release signing as incidental cleanup.
